content: 1. Triad Matrix
(Ka) Wholesome states. ⤵ (Kha) Unwholesome states. ⤵ (Ga) Indeterminate states.
(Ka) States associated with pleasant feeling. ⤵ (Kha) States associated with painful feeling. ⤵ (Ga) States associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.
(Ka) Resultant states. ⤵ (Kha) States with resultant quality. ⤵ (Ga) States that are neither resultant nor have resultant quality.
(Ka) States clung to and fit for clinging. ⤵ (Kha) States not clung to but fit for clinging. ⤵ (Ga) States neither clung to nor fit for clinging.
(Ka) States that are defiled and defiling. ⤵ (Kha) States that are not defiled but defiling. ⤵ (Ga) States that are neither defiled nor defiling.
States with initial and sustained application ⤵ States with only sustained application ⤵ States without initial and sustained application.
States accompanied by zest ⤵ States accompanied by happiness ⤵ States accompanied by equanimity.
States to be abandoned by seeing ⤵ States to be abandoned by development ⤵ States to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development.
States whose roots are to be abandoned by seeing ⤵ States whose roots are to be abandoned by development ⤵ States whose roots are neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development.
States leading to accumulation ⤵ States leading to diminution ⤵ States leading neither to accumulation nor diminution.
States of trainees ⤵ States of perfected ones ⤵ States of neither trainees nor perfected ones.
Limited states ⤵ Sublime states ⤵ Immeasurable states.
States having a limited object ⤵ States having a sublime object ⤵ States having an immeasurable object.
Inferior states ⤵ Middling states ⤵ Superior states.
States fixed in wrongness ⤵ States fixed in rightness ⤵ Unfixed states.
Phenomena that have the path as object; ⤵ phenomena that have the path as root; ⤵ phenomena that have the path as predominant condition.
Phenomena that have arisen; ⤵ phenomena that have not arisen; ⤵ phenomena that are bound to arise.
Past phenomena; ⤵ future phenomena; ⤵ present phenomena.
Phenomena that have a past object; ⤵ phenomena that have a future object; ⤵ phenomena that have a present object.
Internal phenomena; ⤵ external phenomena; ⤵ internal and external phenomena.
Phenomena that have an internal object; ⤵ phenomena that have an external object; ⤵ phenomena that have an internal and external object.
Visible and impinging phenomena; ⤵ invisible and impinging phenomena; ⤵ invisible and non-impinging phenomena.
Triplet Matrix.
2. Duplet Matrix
Root Cluster
Phenomena that are roots. ⤵ Phenomena that are not roots.
Phenomena accompanied by roots. ⤵ Phenomena not accompanied by roots.
Phenomena associated with roots. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from roots.
Phenomena that are roots and are accompanied by roots. ⤵ Phenomena that are accompanied by roots but are not roots.
Phenomena that are roots and are associated with roots. ⤵ Phenomena that are associated with roots but are not roots.
Phenomena that are not roots, but are accompanied by roots. ⤵ Phenomena that are also not accompanied by roots.
Section on Roots.
Minor Intermediate Dyad.
Phenomena with conditions. ⤵ Phenomena without conditions.
Phenomena that are conditioned. ⤵ Phenomena that are unconditioned.
Visible phenomena ⤵ invisible phenomena.
Impinging phenomena ⤵ non-impinging phenomena.
Material phenomena ⤵ immaterial phenomena.
Mundane phenomena ⤵ supramundane phenomena.
Phenomena knowable by some ⤵ phenomena not knowable by some.
Minor Intermediate Dyads.
Cluster of Taints.
Phenomena that are taints ⤵ phenomena that are not taints.
Tainted phenomena ⤵ untouched by taints phenomena.
Phenomena associated with taints ⤵ phenomena dissociated from taints.
Phenomena that are both cankers and associated with cankers; ⤵ phenomena that are associated with cankers but are not cankers.
Phenomena that are both cankers and conjoined with cankers; ⤵ phenomena that are conjoined with cankers but are not cankers.
However, phenomena disjoined from cankers are also associated with cankers; ⤵ also not associated with cankers.
The Canker Couplet.
The Fetter Couplet.
Phenomena that are fetters; ⤵ phenomena that are not fetters.
Phenomena that are fettering; ⤵ phenomena that are not fettering.
Phenomena conjoined with fetters; ⤵ phenomena disjoined from fetters.
Phenomena that are both fetters and fettering; ⤵ phenomena that are fettering but are not fetters.
Phenomena that are both fetters and conjoined with fetters; ⤵ phenomena that are conjoined with fetters but are not fetters.
(Ka) Phenomena dissociated from fetters are also conducive to fetters. ⤵ (Kha) Also not conducive to fetters.
Group on Fetters.
Group on Knots
(Ka) Phenomena that are knots. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that are not knots.
(Ka) Phenomena conducive to knots. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena not conducive to knots.
(Ka) Phenomena associated with knots. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena dissociated from knots.
(Ka) Phenomena that are knots and conducive to knots. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that are conducive to knots but are not knots.
(Ka) Phenomena that are knots and associated with knots. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that are associated with knots but are not knots.
(Ka) Phenomena dissociated from knots are also conducive to knots. ⤵ (Kha) Also not conducive to knots.
Group on Knots.
Section on Floods
(Ka) Phenomena that are floods. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that are not floods.
(Ka) Phenomena that lead to floods. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that do not lead to floods.
(Ka) Phenomena associated with floods. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena dissociated from floods.
(Ka) Phenomena that are both floods and lead to floods. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that lead to floods but are not floods.
(Ka) Phenomena that are both floods and associated with floods. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that are associated with floods but are not floods.
(Ka) Indeed, phenomena dissociated from floods also lead to floods. ⤵ (Kha) And also do not lead to floods.
Section on Floods.
Section on Yokes
(Ka) Phenomena that are yokes. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that are not yokes.
Phenomena pertaining to yokes. ⤵ Phenomena not pertaining to yokes.
Phenomena associated with yokes. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from yokes.
Phenomena that are yokes and pertain to yokes. ⤵ Phenomena that pertain to yokes but are not yokes.
Phenomena that are yokes and are associated with yokes. ⤵ Phenomena that are associated with yokes but are not yokes.
Phenomena dissociated from yokes, which also pertain to yokes. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from yokes, which also do not pertain to yokes.
Group on Yokes.
Group on Hindrances.
Phenomena that are hindrances. ⤵ Phenomena that are not hindrances.
Phenomena pertaining to hindrances. ⤵ Phenomena not pertaining to hindrances.
Phenomena associated with hindrances. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from hindrances.
(Ka) States that are hindrances and are of the nature of hindrances. ⤵ (Kha) States that are of the nature of hindrances but are not hindrances.
(Ka) States that are hindrances and are associated with hindrances. ⤵ (Kha) States that are associated with hindrances but are not hindrances.
(Ka) States that are dissociated from hindrances, but are of the nature of hindrances. ⤵ (Kha) States that are dissociated from hindrances and are not of the nature of hindrances.
The Hindrance Group.
The Misapprehension Group.
(Ka) States that are misapprehensions. ⤵ (Kha) States that are not misapprehensions.
(Ka) States that are misapprehended. ⤵ (Kha) States that are unmisapprehended.
(Ka) States that are associated with misapprehension. ⤵ (Kha) States that are dissociated from misapprehension.
(Ka) States that are both misapprehensions and misapprehended. ⤵ (Kha) States that are misapprehended but are not misapprehensions.
(Ka) States that are dissociated from misapprehension, but are misapprehended. ⤵ (Kha) States that are dissociated from misapprehension and are unmisapprehended.
Cluster of Grasping
The Great Pairs
Phenomena with objects ⤵ Phenomena without objects
Phenomena that are consciousness ⤵ Phenomena that are not consciousness
Phenomena that are mental factors ⤵ Phenomena that are not mental factors
Phenomena associated with consciousness ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from consciousness
Phenomena conjoined with consciousness ⤵ Phenomena unconjoined with consciousness
Phenomena originated by consciousness ⤵ Phenomena not originated by consciousness
Phenomena co-arising with consciousness ⤵ Phenomena not co-arising with consciousness
Phenomena following consciousness ⤵ Phenomena not following consciousness
Phenomena that arise from and are associated with consciousness. ⤵ Phenomena that do not arise from and are not associated with consciousness.
Phenomena that are co-existent with those arising from and associated with consciousness. ⤵ Phenomena that are not co-existent with those arising from and associated with consciousness.

Phenomena that accompany or are dependent on those arising from and associated with consciousness. ⤵ Phenomena that do not accompany or are not dependent on those arising from and associated with consciousness.
Internal phenomena. ⤵ External phenomena.
Derived phenomena. ⤵ Non-derived phenomena.
Karmically conditioned or grasped phenomena. ⤵ Non-karmically conditioned or not grasped phenomena.
The Great Intermediate Pair.
The Group on Clinging/Grasping.
Phenomena that are clinging itself. ⤵ Phenomena that are not clinging itself.
Phenomena that are objects of clinging. ⤵ Phenomena that are not objects of clinging.
Phenomena associated with clinging. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from clinging.
Phenomena that are clinging itself and are also objects of clinging. ⤵ Phenomena that are objects of clinging but are not clinging itself.
Phenomena that are clinging itself and are associated with clinging. ⤵ Phenomena that are associated with clinging but are not clinging itself.
Phenomena dissociated from clinging that are also objects of clinging. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from clinging and not objects of clinging.
The Clinging Group.
The Defilement Group.
Phenomena that are defilements. ⤵ Phenomena that are not defilements.
Phenomena that are defiling. ⤵ Phenomena that are not defiling.
Phenomena that are defiled. ⤵ Phenomena that are undefiled.
Phenomena associated with defilements. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from defilements.
Phenomena that are both defilements and defiling ⤵ Phenomena that are defiling but not defilements.
Phenomena that are both defilements and defiled ⤵ Phenomena that are defiled but not defilements.
Phenomena that are both defilements and associated with defilements ⤵ Phenomena that are associated with defilements but not defilements.
Phenomena dissociated from defilements, but also defiling ⤵ And also non-defiling.
Cluster of Defilements.
Pairs of Backs/Foundations.
Phenomena to be abandoned by insight ⤵ Phenomena not to be abandoned by insight.
Phenomena to be abandoned by development ⤵ Phenomena not to be abandoned by development.
Phenomena whose roots are to be abandoned by insight ⤵ Phenomena whose roots are not to be abandoned by insight.
Phenomena whose roots are to be abandoned by development ⤵ Phenomena whose roots are not to be abandoned by development.
Phenomena accompanied by initial application ⤵ Phenomena without initial application.
Phenomena accompanied by sustained application ⤵ Phenomena without sustained application.
Phenomena accompanied by zest ⤵ Phenomena without zest.
Phenomena accompanied by zest ⤵ Phenomena not accompanied by zest.
Phenomena accompanied by pleasant feeling ⤵ Phenomena not accompanied by pleasant feeling.
Phenomena accompanied by equanimity ⤵ Phenomena not accompanied by equanimity.
Phenomena of the sense sphere ⤵ Phenomena not of the sense sphere.
Phenomena of the fine-material sphere ⤵ Phenomena not of the fine-material sphere.
Phenomena of the immaterial sphere ⤵ Phenomena not of the immaterial sphere.
Included phenomena ⤵ Unincluded phenomena.
States that lead to liberation ⤵ States that do not lead to liberation.
States that are fixed ⤵ States that are unfixed.
States that have a beyond ⤵ States that have no beyond.
States that are harmful ⤵ States that are harmless.
End of pairs.
Abhidhamma Pairs Matrix.
Suttanta Pairs Matrix
States that partake of wisdom ⤵ States that partake of ignorance.
States that resemble lightning ⤵ States that resemble a thunderbolt.
States that are foolish ⤵ States that are wise.
Dark states ⤵ Bright states.
States that cause torment ⤵ States that do not cause torment.
Designations ⤵ Paths of designation.
Expressions ⤵ Paths of expression.
Concepts ⤵ Paths of concept.
Mentality ⤵ Materiality.
Ignorance ⤵ Craving for existence.
View of eternalism ⤵ View of annihilationism.
Eternalist view ⤵ Annihilationist view.
View that the world is finite ⤵ View that the world is infinite.

Shamelessness ⤵ fearlessness of wrongdoing.
Moral shame ⤵ moral dread.

Tractability ⤵ good friendship.

Uprightness ⤵ Gentleness

Friendliness ⤵ Hospitality

Guarded sense doors ⤵ Moderation in food
Forgetfulness ⤵ Lack of clear comprehension
Mindfulness ⤵ Clear comprehension
Power of reflection ⤵ Power of development
Tranquility ⤵ Insight
Sign of tranquility ⤵ Sign of exertion
Exertion ⤵ and collectedness.
Moral failure ⤵ and theoretic fallacy.
Moral achievement ⤵ and theoretic achievement.
Purity of morals ⤵ and purity of view.
Purity of view ⤵ and the exertion of one who holds the view.
Spiritual urgency in agitating situations ⤵ and the appropriate exertion of one who is spiritually urgent.
Discontent with wholesome states ⤵ and unfalteringness in exertion.
Wisdom ⤵ and liberation.
Knowledge of ending ⤵ and knowledge of non-arising.
Suttanta Dyad Matrix.
The outline is finished.

Which states are wholesome?⤵When a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness, accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge, has arisen, taking as its object a visible form, or a sound, or an odor, or a taste, or a tangible, or a mental object, or whatever else it may take as object, then there is:⤵contact⤵feeling⤵perception⤵volition⤵consciousness⤵initial application⤵sustained application⤵zest⤵happiness⤵one-pointedness of consciousness⤵faculty of faith⤵faculty of energy⤵faculty of mindfulness⤵faculty of concentration⤵faculty of wisdom⤵faculty of mind⤵faculty of joy⤵life faculty⤵right view⤵right intention⤵right effort⤵right mindfulness⤵right concentration⤵power of faith⤵power of energy⤵power of mindfulness⤵power of concentration⤵power of wisdom⤵power of shame⤵power of fear of wrongdoing⤵non-greed⤵non-hatred⤵non-delusion⤵non-covetousness⤵non-ill-will⤵right view⤵shame⤵fear of wrongdoing⤵tranquillity of mental body⤵tranquillity of consciousness⤵lightness of mental body⤵lightness of consciousness⤵malleability of mental body⤵malleability of consciousness⤵wieldiness of mental body⤵wieldiness of consciousness⤵proficiency of mental body⤵proficiency of consciousness⤵rectitude of mental body⤵rectitude of consciousness⤵mindfulness⤵clear comprehension⤵calm⤵insight⤵exertion⤵non-distraction.⤵And whatever other formless states there are that have arisen dependently at that moment – these states are wholesome.
What on that occasion is contact? The contact which on that occasion is touching, complete touching, the state of having completely touched – this is the contact that there then is.

What on that occasion is feeling? The mental pleasantness, the mental happiness, which on that occasion is born of contact with the mind-consciousness element; the pleasant, happy sensation born of contact with consciousness; the pleasant, happy feeling born of contact with consciousness – this is the feeling that there then is.

What on that occasion is perception? The perception, the perceiving, the state of having perceived which on that occasion is born of contact with the mind-consciousness element – this is the perception that there then is.

What on that occasion is volition? The volition, intending, the state of having intended which on that occasion is born of contact with the mind-consciousness element – this is the volition that there then is.

What on that occasion is consciousness? The consciousness which on that occasion is mind, mentality, heart, the pure, mind-base, mind-faculty, consciousness, aggregate of consciousness, the mind-consciousness element – this is the consciousness that there then is.

What on that occasion is initial application?⤵The reasoning, initial application, intention, placing, applying, placing the mind on, right intention, which on that occasion is —this is the initial application that there then is.

What on that occasion is sustained application?⤵The sustained application, pondering, examining, the mind's continual application, sustained examination, which on that occasion is —this is the sustained application that there then is.
What on that occasion is rapture?⤵The rapture, joy, delight, gladness, mirth, great mirth, thrill, elation, mental satisfaction, which on that occasion is —this is the rapture that there then is.

What on that occasion is happiness?⤵The mental pleasantness, mental happiness, pleasant happy experience born of mental contact, pleasant happy feeling born of mental contact, which on that occasion is —this is the happiness that there then is.

What on that occasion is one-pointedness of mind?⤵The mind's stability, firm stability, non-wavering, non-distraction, non-scattering, undistractedness of mind, calm, faculty of concentration, power of concentration, right concentration, which on that occasion is —this is the one-pointedness of mind that there then is.

What on that occasion is the faculty of faith?⤵The faith, trusting, confidence, serene confidence, faith as a faculty, power of faith, which on that occasion is —this is the faculty of faith that there then is.

What on that occasion is the faculty of energy?⤵The mental inception of energy, striving, effort, exertion, endeavor, zeal, ardor, vigor, fortitude, unfaltering effort, sustained desire, unflinching endurance, solid grip of the burden, energy, faculty of energy, power of energy, right effort, which on that occasion is —this is the faculty of energy that there then is.

What on that occasion is the faculty of mindfulness?⤵The mindfulness, recollection, remembering, bearing in mind, non-superficiality, non-forgetfulness, mindfulness as a faculty, power of mindfulness, right mindfulness, which on that occasion is —this is the faculty of mindfulness that there then is.

What on that occasion is the faculty of concentration?⤵The mind's stability, firm stability, non-wavering, non-distraction, non-scattering, undistractedness of mind, calm, faculty of concentration, power of concentration, right concentration, which on that occasion is —this is the faculty of concentration that there then is.

What on that occasion is the faculty of wisdom?⤵The wisdom, understanding, search, research, investigation of phenomena, discernment, discrimination, differentiation, erudition, proficiency, subtlety, criticism, reflection, analysis, breadth, sagacity, a guide, insight, clear comprehension, goad, wisdom as a faculty, power of wisdom, wisdom as a sword, wisdom as a height, wisdom as light, wisdom as glory, wisdom as splendor, wisdom as a precious stone, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view, which on that occasion is —this is the faculty of wisdom that there then is.

What on that occasion is the mind faculty?⤵That which on that occasion is consciousness, mind, mentality, intellect, mind base, mind faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, the mind-consciousness element—this is the mind faculty on that occasion.

What on that occasion is the faculty of mental pleasure?⤵That which on that occasion is mental pleasantness, mental happiness, a pleasant and happy feeling born of mental contact—this is the faculty of mental pleasure on that occasion.

What on that occasion is the life faculty?⤵That which on that occasion is the life, persistence, maintenance, sustenance, going on, continuance, preservation, life, life faculty of those immaterial phenomena—this is the life faculty on that occasion.

What on that occasion is right view?⤵That which on that occasion is wisdom, understanding, investigation, thorough investigation, investigation of phenomena, discernment, observation, close observation, sagacity, skill, proficiency, analysis, thought, examination, wisdom, intelligence, guidance, insight, clear comprehension, goad, wisdom, wisdom faculty, power of wisdom, wisdom's weapon, wisdom's palace, wisdom's light, wisdom's radiance, wisdom's illumination, wisdom's gem, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view—this is right view on that occasion.

What on that occasion is right intention?⤵That which on that occasion is thought, initial application, intention, application, thorough application, directing of mind, right intention—this is right intention on that occasion.

What on that occasion is right effort?⤵That which on that occasion is mental energy, exertion, effort, striving, endeavor, enthusiasm, perseverance, strength, firmness, unflagging effort, unabandoned desire, unabandoned burden, undertaking the burden, energy, energy faculty, power of energy, right effort—this is right effort on that occasion.

What on that occasion is right mindfulness?⤵That which on that occasion is mindfulness, recollection, repeated recollection, remembering, holding in mind, non-forgetfulness, non-confusion, mindfulness, mindfulness faculty, power of mindfulness, right mindfulness—this is right mindfulness on that occasion.

What on that occasion is right concentration?⤵That which on that occasion is the mind's stability, steadfastness, immobility, non-distraction, non-scattering, undistracted mentality, calm, concentration faculty, power of concentration, right concentration—this is right concentration on that occasion.

What on that occasion is the power of faith?⤵That which on that occasion is faith, confidence, conviction, serene trust, faith, faith faculty, power of faith—this is the power of faith on that occasion.

What on that occasion is the power of mindfulness?⤵That mindfulness, recollection, remembrance, holding in mind, not floating away, not forgetting; the faculty of mindfulness, the power of mindfulness, right mindfulness, which there is on that occasion—this is the power of mindfulness on that occasion.

What on that occasion is the power of concentration?⤵That mental stability, firmness, non-wavering, non-distraction, non-scatteredness of mind, tranquility; the faculty of concentration, the power of concentration, right concentration, which there is on that occasion—this is the power of concentration on that occasion.

What on that occasion is the power of wisdom?⤵That wisdom, knowing thoroughly, investigation, thorough investigation, investigation of phenomena, discernment, sagacity, skill, analysis, reflection, understanding, intelligence, insight, comprehension, goad, wisdom; the faculty of wisdom, the power of wisdom, the weapon of wisdom, the palace of wisdom, the light of wisdom, the radiance of wisdom, the lamp of wisdom, the gem of wisdom, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view, which there is on that occasion—this is the power of wisdom on that occasion.

What on that occasion is the power of moral shame?⤵That moral shame, being ashamed of what one should be ashamed of, being ashamed of engaging in evil, unwholesome states, which there is on that occasion—this is the power of moral shame on that occasion.

What on that occasion is the power of moral dread?⤵That moral dread, fearing what one should fear, fearing engaging in evil, unwholesome states, which there is on that occasion—this is the power of moral dread on that occasion.

What on that occasion is non-greed?⤵That non-greed, not being greedy, the state of not being greedy, non-attachment, not being attached, the state of not being attached, non-covetousness, non-greed, a root of wholesome action, which there is on that occasion—this is non-greed on that occasion.

What on that occasion is non-hatred?⤵That non-hatred, not being hateful, the state of not being hateful, non-ill-will, not being malicious, non-hatred, a root of wholesome action, which there is on that occasion—this is non-hatred on that occasion.

What on that occasion is non-delusion?⤵That wisdom, knowing thoroughly, investigation, thorough investigation, investigation of phenomena, discernment, sagacity, skill, analysis, reflection, understanding, intelligence, insight, comprehension, goad, wisdom; the faculty of wisdom, the power of wisdom, the weapon of wisdom, the palace of wisdom, the light of wisdom, the radiance of wisdom, the lamp of wisdom, the gem of wisdom, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view, non-delusion, a root of wholesome action, which there is on that occasion—this is non-delusion on that occasion.

What on that occasion is non-covetousness?⤵That non-greed, not being greedy, the state of not being greedy, non-attachment, not being attached, the state of not being attached, non-covetousness, non-greed, a root of wholesome action, which there is on that occasion—this is non-covetousness on that occasion.

What on that occasion is non-ill-will?⤵That non-hatred, not being hateful, the state of not being hateful, non-ill-will, not being malicious, non-hatred, a root of wholesome action, which there is on that occasion—this is non-ill-will on that occasion.

What on that occasion is right view?⤵That which on that occasion is wisdom, knowing, investigation, discernment, sagacity, skill, proficiency, analysis, examination, intelligence, insight, clear comprehension, the faculty of wisdom, the power of wisdom, the light of wisdom, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view—this is right view on that occasion.

What on that occasion is moral shame?⤵That which on that occasion is shame, being ashamed of what is shameful, being ashamed of engaging in evil, unwholesome states—this is moral shame on that occasion.
What on that occasion is moral dread?⤵That which on that occasion is dread, dreading what is dreadful, dreading engagement in evil, unwholesome states—this is moral dread on that occasion.

What on that occasion is tranquillity of mental factors?⤵That which on that occasion is the tranquillity, calming, subsiding, and pacification of the feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, and the volitional formations aggregate—this is tranquillity of mental factors on that occasion.

What on that occasion is tranquillity of consciousness?⤵That which on that occasion is the tranquillity, calming, subsiding, and pacification of the consciousness aggregate—this is tranquillity of consciousness on that occasion.

What on that occasion is lightness of mental factors?⤵That which on that occasion is the lightness, adaptability, non-sluggishness, and non-heaviness of the feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, and the volitional formations aggregate—this is lightness of mental factors on that occasion.

What on that occasion is lightness of consciousness?⤵That which on that occasion is the lightness, adaptability, non-sluggishness, and non-heaviness of the consciousness aggregate—this is lightness of consciousness on that occasion.

What on that occasion is malleability of mental factors?⤵That which on that occasion is the malleability, pliancy, non-harshness, and non-rigidity of the feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, and the volitional formations aggregate—this is malleability of mental factors on that occasion.

What on that occasion is malleability of consciousness?⤵That which on that occasion is the malleability, pliancy, non-harshness, and non-rigidity of the consciousness aggregate—this is malleability of consciousness on that occasion.

What on that occasion is wieldiness of mental factors?⤵That which on that occasion is the wieldiness, fitness for work, and serviceability of the feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, and the volitional formations aggregate—this is wieldiness of mental factors on that occasion.
What is workability of mind on that occasion?⤵The wieldiness, workability, or fitness of the consciousness aggregate on that occasion—this is workability of mind on that occasion.

What is proficiency of mental body on that occasion?⤵The proficiency, dexterity, or skillfulness of the feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, and volitional formations aggregate on that occasion—this is proficiency of mental body on that occasion.
What is proficiency of mind on that occasion?⤵The proficiency, dexterity, or skillfulness of the consciousness aggregate on that occasion—this is proficiency of mind on that occasion.

What is rectitude of mental body on that occasion?⤵The straightness, uprightness, non-crookedness, non-bentness, or non-deviousness of the feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, and volitional formations aggregate on that occasion—this is rectitude of mental body on that occasion.

What is rectitude of mind on that occasion?⤵The straightness, uprightness, non-crookedness, non-bentness, or non-deviousness of the consciousness aggregate on that occasion—this is rectitude of mind on that occasion.

What is mindfulness on that occasion?⤵The mindfulness, recollection, remembering, not forgetting, not losing, the faculty of mindfulness, the power of mindfulness, and right mindfulness on that occasion—this is mindfulness on that occasion.

What is clear comprehension on that occasion?⤵The wisdom, understanding, investigation, discernment, insight, skill, intelligence, examination, analysis, penetration, non-delusion, and right view on that occasion—this is clear comprehension on that occasion.

What is tranquility on that occasion?⤵The stability, steadfastness, non-distraction, non-agitation, and unscatteredness of mind, the concentration faculty, the concentration power, and right concentration on that occasion—this is tranquility on that occasion.

What is insight on that occasion?⤵The wisdom, understanding, investigation, discernment, insight, skill, intelligence, examination, analysis, penetration, non-delusion, and right view on that occasion—this is insight on that occasion.

What is feeling at that time?⤵Whatever mental pleasantness, mental pleasure, pleasant pleasure born of mind-consciousness element contact, pleasant and pleasurable feeling born of mind-contact at that time – this is feeling at that time.

What is perception at that time?⤵That perception, cognizing, state of having cognized, born of contact with the mind-consciousness element pertaining to that [object] at that time – this is perception at that time.

What on that occasion is Right View?⤵The wisdom on that occasion is understanding, knowing, investigation, thorough investigation, investigation of phenomena, discernment, distinguishing, differentiation, erudition, skill, adroitness, analysis, thought, examination, insight, intelligence, leading, insight, clear comprehension, stimulus; wisdom, the faculty of wisdom, the power of wisdom, wisdom's weapon, wisdom's palace, wisdom's light, wisdom's aura, wisdom's radiance, wisdom's jewel; non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, Right View, the enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena, a path factor, included in the path—this is Right View that there then is.

What on that occasion is Right Intention?⤵That which on that occasion is thought, initial application, intention, directing, fixing of the mind; Right Intention, a path factor, included in the path—this is Right Intention that there then is.

What on that occasion is Right Speech?⤵That which on that occasion is abstinence, refraining, desisting, avoidance from the four wrong speech acts; non-doing, non-committing, non-transgression, non-overstepping of boundaries, destruction of the causeway; Right Speech, a path factor, included in the path—this is Right Speech that there then is.

What on that occasion is Right Action?⤵At that time, the abstaining, refraining, desisting, and abstinence from the three bodily wrong actions; non-doing, non-performance, non-transgression, not overstepping the boundary, breaking the bridge (to wrong action)—Right Action, a path factor, included in the path—this is the Right Action that there then is.

What on that occasion is Right Livelihood?⤵At that time, the abstaining, refraining, desisting, and abstinence from wrong livelihood; non-doing, non-performance, non-transgression, not overstepping the boundary, breaking the bridge (to wrong livelihood)—Right Livelihood, a path factor, included in the path—this is the Right Livelihood that there then is.

What on that occasion is Right Concentration?⤵At that time, the standing, firm standing, steadfast standing of the mind; non-distraction, non-scattering, non-distractedness of mind, tranquility; the concentration faculty, the power of concentration, Right Concentration, the enlightenment factor of concentration, a path factor, included in the path—this is the Right Concentration that there then is.

What on that occasion is the Power of Faith?⤵At that time, faith, believing, conviction, entrusting, serene confidence; faith, the faith faculty, the power of faith—this is the Power of Faith that there then is.

What on that occasion is the Power of Effort?⤵At that time, the mental exertion, initiation of energy, effort, endeavor, zeal, vigor, strength, steadfastness, unslackening exertion, unabandoned desire, unabandoned burden, taking up the burden; energy, the energy faculty, the power of effort, Right Effort, the enlightenment factor of effort, a path factor, included in the path—this is the Power of Effort that there then is.

Which phenomena are wholesome? Those phenomena when one cultivates a supramundane jhana, which is emancipating, leading to the reduction of defilements, for the abandonment of wrong views, for the attainment of the first stage of enlightenment, secluded from sensual pleasures…etc. and abides having attained the first jhana with painful practice and swift direct knowledge; at that time there is contact…etc. there is non-distraction…etc. these phenomena are wholesome.

Twelve unwholesome states.

Which phenomena are unwholesome? When unwholesome consciousness arises, accompanied by joy and associated with wrong view, having a visible object, or a sound object, or a smell object, or a taste object, or a tangible object, or a mental object, or whatever it may be based on, on that occasion there is ⤵contact, ⤵feeling, ⤵perception, ⤵volition, ⤵consciousness, ⤵initial application, ⤵sustained application, ⤵zest, ⤵happiness, ⤵one-pointedness of mind; ⤵faculty of energy, ⤵faculty of concentration, ⤵faculty of mind, ⤵faculty of joy, ⤵life faculty; ⤵wrong view, ⤵wrong intention, ⤵wrong effort, ⤵wrong concentration; ⤵power of energy, ⤵power of concentration, ⤵power of shamelessness, ⤵power of fearlessness of wrongdoing; ⤵greed, ⤵delusion, ⤵covetousness, ⤵wrong view, ⤵shamelessness, ⤵fearlessness of wrongdoing; ⤵calm, ⤵exertion, ⤵non-distraction; or whatever other immaterial, conditionally arisen phenomena there are on that occasion – these phenomena are unwholesome.
What is contact on that occasion? That which on that occasion is contact, touching, being in contact – this is contact on that occasion.
What is feeling on that occasion? That which on that occasion is mental pleasantness, mental happiness, feeling born of contact with the mind-consciousness element – this is feeling on that occasion.
What is perception on that occasion? That which on that occasion is perception, perceiving, being perceived, born of contact with the mind-consciousness element – this is perception on that occasion.
What is volition on that occasion? That which on that occasion is volition, intending, being intended, born of contact with the mind-consciousness element – this is volition on that occasion.

What is consciousness on that occasion? That which on that occasion is consciousness, mind, mental, mind base, mind faculty, consciousness, aggregate of consciousness, mind-consciousness element – this is consciousness on that occasion.

What on that occasion is initial application?⤵That which on that occasion is thought, initial application, intention, fixing, clear fixing, projecting of the mind onto the object, wrong intention – this on that occasion is initial application.

What on that occasion is sustained application?⤵That which on that occasion is wandering, sustained application, continued investigation, close investigation, continuous application of the mind, repeated examination – this on that occasion is sustained application.
What on that occasion is joy?⤵That which on that occasion is joy, delight, enjoyment, great enjoyment, mirth, great mirth, elation, gladness of mind – this on that occasion is joy.

What on that occasion is initial application? The thinking, initial application, intention, fixing, applying, or directing of the mind that there then is—this is the initial application that there then is.

What on that occasion is sustained application? The sustained application, investigation, continuous investigation, repeated investigation, or contemplation of the mind that there then is—this is the sustained application that there then is.

What on that occasion is equanimity? The mental factor that on that occasion is neither pleasant nor unpleasant, born of mental contact, the neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling born of mental contact—this is the equanimity that there then is.
What on that occasion is one-pointedness of mind? The stability or steadfastness of the mind that there then is—this is the one-pointedness of mind that there then is.

What on that occasion is the mind-faculty? The consciousness, mind, mentality, heart, intellect, mind-base, mind-faculty, cognition, aggregate of consciousness, that mind-element that there then is—this is the mind-faculty that there then is.

What on that occasion is the faculty of equanimity? That mental factor on that occasion which is neither pleasant nor unpleasant, a feeling born of mental contact, a neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling born of mental contact—this on that occasion is the faculty of equanimity.

What on that occasion is the life faculty? That which on that occasion is the life, presence, maintenance, sustenance, activity, continuation, preservation, life, life faculty of those formless phenomena—this on that occasion is the life faculty; or whatever other dependently arisen formless phenomena are present on that occasion—these phenomena are indeterminate. ⤵ On that occasion there are four aggregates, two bases, two elements, three nutriments, three faculties, one contact... one mind element, one dhamma-base, one dhamma-element; or whatever other dependently arisen formless phenomena are present on that occasion—these phenomena are indeterminate....

Indeterminate Resultant of Unwholesome Kamma
The Five Resultant Unwholesome Sense-Consciousnesses

Which states are indeterminate?⤵When, as the result of unwholesome kamma having been wrought, having been stored up, eye-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, having visible form as its object; ear-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, having sound as its object; nose-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, having smell as its object; tongue-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, having taste as its object; body-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by pain, having tangible object as its object, then at that time there is contact, feeling, perception, volition, consciousness, pain, one-pointedness of mind, mind faculty, pain faculty, life faculty; or whatever other immaterial phenomena there are at that time, arisen dependently – these phenomena are indeterminate.
What is contact at that time? Whatever contact, touching, full touching, the state of having fully touched there is at that time – this is contact at that time.

What is feeling at that time? Whatever bodily unpleasantness, bodily pain, unpleasant painful sensation born of body-contact, unpleasant painful feeling born of body-contact there is at that time, born of contact with the appropriate body-consciousness element – this is feeling at that time.

What is pain at that time? Whatever bodily unpleasantness, bodily pain, unpleasant painful sensation born of body-contact, unpleasant painful feeling born of body-contact there is at that time – this is pain at that time.

What is the pain faculty at that time? Whatever bodily unpleasantness, bodily pain, unpleasant painful sensation born of body-contact, unpleasant painful feeling born of body-contact there is at that time – this is the pain faculty at that time; or whatever other immaterial phenomena there are at that time, arisen dependently – these phenomena are indeterminate.⤵At that time there are four aggregates, two sense bases, two elements, three nutriments, three faculties, one contact, one body-consciousness element, one mind-object base, one mind-object element; or whatever other immaterial phenomena there are at that time, arisen dependently – these phenomena are indeterminate.

What is the aggregate of formations at that time? Contact, volition, one-pointedness of mind, life faculty; or whatever other immaterial phenomena there are at that time, arisen dependently, excluding the aggregate of feeling, excluding the aggregate of perception, excluding the aggregate of consciousness – this is the aggregate of formations at that time; these phenomena are indeterminate.

When a functional mind-consciousness-element, which is neither wholesome nor unwholesome nor resultant of kamma, accompanied by joy, arises, having as its object a visible form...or a mind-object, or whatever else it apprehends, at that time there is contact, feeling, perception, volition, consciousness, initial application, sustained application, zest, happiness, one-pointedness of mind, energy faculty, concentration faculty, mind faculty, joy faculty, life faculty; and whatever other formless, dependently arisen states there are at that time—these states are indeterminate.
What is contact at that time? That which at that time is contact, touching, coming into contact, the state of having come into contact—this is contact at that time.

What is one-pointedness of mind at that time? That which at that time is the mind's stability, steadfastness, non-wavering, non-distraction, tranquility, unscattered mental state, calm, concentration faculty, concentration power—this is one-pointedness of mind at that time.

What is the energy faculty at that time? That which at that time is mental exertion, effort, striving, energy, enthusiasm, strength, steadfastness, unflagging determination, unabandoned desire, unabandoned burden, the undertaking of the burden, energy, the energy faculty, the power of energy—this is the energy faculty at that time.

What is the faculty of concentration at that time? The mind's stability, steadfastness, non-wavering, non-distraction, non-scattering, tranquility, faculty of concentration, power of concentration at that time – this is the faculty of concentration at that time. ... And whatever other formless, conditionally arisen phenomena exist at that time – these phenomena are indeterminate. ⤵ At that time there are four aggregates, two bases, two elements, three nutriments, five faculties, one contact ... one mind-consciousness element, one dhamma base, one dhamma element; and whatever other formless, conditionally arisen phenomena exist at that time – these phenomena are indeterminate.

What is the aggregate of formations at that time? Contact, volition, initial application, sustained application, zest, one-pointedness of mind, the faculty of energy, the faculty of concentration, the life faculty; and whatever other formless, conditionally arisen phenomena exist at that time, excluding the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of consciousness – this is the aggregate of formations at that time. ... These phenomena are indeterminate.
Functional mind-consciousness element accompanied by joy.
Functional Mind-Consciousness Element Accompanied by Equanimity

Which phenomena are indeterminate? When a functional mind-consciousness element has arisen, which is neither wholesome, unwholesome, nor a karmic result, accompanied by equanimity, having a form object or ... a dhamma object, or whatever it takes as its object, at that time there is contact, feeling, perception, volition, consciousness, initial application, sustained application, equanimity, one-pointedness of mind, the faculty of energy, the faculty of concentration, the mind faculty, the equanimity faculty, the life faculty; and whatever other formless, conditionally arisen phenomena exist at that time – these phenomena are indeterminate. ⤵ At that time there are four aggregates, two bases, two elements, three nutriments, five faculties, one contact ... one mind-consciousness element, one dhamma base, one dhamma element; and whatever other formless, conditionally arisen phenomena exist at that time – these phenomena are indeterminate.

These phenomena are indeterminate.
Functional mind-consciousness element accompanied by equanimity.

Rooted Sense-Sphere Functional

Which phenomena are indeterminate? When a functional mind-consciousness element has arisen, which is neither wholesome, unwholesome, nor a karmic result, accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge ... accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge, and prompted ... accompanied by joy and dissociated from knowledge ... accompanied by joy, dissociated from knowledge, and prompted ... accompanied by equanimity and associated with knowledge ... accompanied by equanimity, associated with knowledge, and prompted ... accompanied by equanimity and dissociated from knowledge ... accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge, and prompted, having a form object or ... a dhamma object, or whatever it takes as its object, at that time there is contact ... non-scattering ... these phenomena are indeterminate. ... These phenomena are indeterminate.

These phenomena are indeterminate.

Which phenomena are indeterminate? Which phenomena are indeterminate? Which phenomena are indeterminate? Functional and indeterminate.
The Chapter on the Arising of Consciousness is concluded.

Summary

Which states are indeterminate?⤵The results of wholesome and unwholesome states in the sense-sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere, or unincluded, as the aggregates of feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness; and those functional states which are neither wholesome nor unwholesome, and not results of kamma; and all form; and the unconditioned element—these states are indeterminate.

In this connection, what is all form?⤵The four great primary elements, and form derived from the four great primary elements—this is called all form. What is the material phenomenon that is bodily intimation?⤵That tension, intentness, stiffening of the body, in one who is advancing or retreating, looking or glancing around, bending or stretching, due to a wholesome mind or unwholesome mind or indeterminate mind; the intimation, the making known, the state of having made known—this is that material phenomenon which is bodily intimation.

What is the material phenomenon that is the space element?⤵That which is space, spatiality, non-obstruction, aperture, uncontacted by the four great primaries—this is that material phenomenon which is the space element.

What is that matter which is the wieldiness of matter?⤵That wieldiness of matter which is fitness for work, suitability—this is that matter which is the wieldiness of matter.
What is that matter which is the growth of matter?⤵That which is the accumulation of the sense bases, that is the growth of matter—this is that matter which is the growth of matter.
What is that matter which is the continuity of matter?⤵That which is the growth of matter, that is the continuity of matter—this is that matter which is the continuity of matter.

What is that matter which is the decay of matter?⤵That decay of matter which is old age, decay, brokenness, greyness, wrinkling of skin, decline of life, ripening of the faculties—this is that matter which is the decay of matter.

What is that matter which is the impermanence of matter?⤵That impermanence of matter which is destruction, passing away, breaking up, complete breaking up, impermanence, disappearance—this is that matter which is the impermanence of matter.

What is that matter which is edible food?⤵Rice, gruel, flour, fish, meat, milk, curds, ghee, fresh butter, oil, honey, molasses, or any other matter which in any country serves as food for beings, to be put into the mouth, chewed by the teeth, swallowed down the throat, filling the stomach, by the nutrient essence of which beings subsist—this is that matter which is edible food.
This is that matter which is derived.

The earth element, fire element, air element; hard, soft, smooth, rough, pleasant to touch, painful to touch, heavy, light; that tangible, concerning which, depending on the body, bodily contact has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵and, born of that bodily contact, feeling has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵perception has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵volition has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵body-consciousness has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵further, that which has the tangible as its object, depending on the body, bodily contact has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵and, born of that bodily contact, feeling has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵perception has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵volition has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵body-consciousness has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise—this is that materiality, the tangible base.

Thus, the compendium of matter is in three ways.
Explanation of the Triads.
Tetrads.

Which matter is sustained by clinging and grasped by kamma? Eye-base... up to... body-base, femininity faculty, masculinity faculty, life faculty, or whatever other matter there is that is kamma-produced: visible form base, smell base, taste base, space element, production of matter, continuity of matter, physical nutriment – this is that matter sustained by clinging and grasped by kamma.

Which matter is sustained by clinging but not grasped by kamma? Sound base, bodily intimation, vocal intimation, lightness of matter, malleability of matter, wieldiness of matter, decay of matter, impermanence of matter, or whatever other matter there is that is not kamma-produced: visible form base, smell base, taste base, space element, production of matter, continuity of matter, physical nutriment – this is that matter sustained by clinging but not grasped by kamma.
Which matter is not sustained by clinging but grasped by kamma? The tangible base and water element that are kamma-produced – this is that matter not sustained by clinging but grasped by kamma.

Which matter is neither sustained by clinging nor grasped by kamma? The tangible base and water element that are not kamma-produced – this is that matter neither sustained by clinging nor grasped by kamma.

What is that material phenomenon which is not a faculty and proximate?⤵The visible object…pe… the tangible object. This is that material phenomenon which is not a faculty and proximate.
What is that matter which is a great element and is gross? The tangible sense base. This is that matter which is a great element and is gross.
What is that matter which is a great element and is subtle? The water element. This is that matter which is a great element and is subtle.
What is that matter which is not a great element but is gross? The eye sense base... the taste sense base. This is that matter which is not a great element but is gross.
What is that matter which is not a great element and is subtle? The female faculty... nutritive essence. This is that matter which is not a great element and is subtle.
What is that matter which is a great element and is remote? The water element. This is that matter which is a great element and is remote.
What is that matter which is a great element and is proximate? The tangible sense base. This is that matter which is a great element and is proximate.
What is that matter which is not a great element and is remote? The female faculty... nutritive essence. This is that matter which is not a great element and is remote.
What is that matter which is not a great element and is proximate? The eye sense base... the taste sense base. This is that matter which is not a great element and is proximate.
Visible form is seen,⤵sound is heard,⤵smell, taste, and tangible objects are sensed,⤵all matter is matter cognized by the mind.
Thus, the compilation of matter is fourfold.
The Tetrad.
The Pentad

What is the matter that is the earth element? That which is hardness, hard, the state of hardness, the nature of hardness, whether internal or external, grasped or not grasped – this is that matter, the earth element.

What is the matter that is the water element? That which is water, watery, cohesion, cohesive, the binding of matter, whether internal or external, grasped or not grasped – this is that matter, the water element.
What is the matter that is the fire element? That which is fire, fiery, heat, hot, warmth, warm, whether internal or external, grasped or not grasped – this is that matter, the fire element.
What is the matter that is the air element? That which is air, airy, the quality of support of matter, whether internal or external, grasped or not grasped – this is that matter, the air element.
What is the derived matter? The eye-base… (and so on)… edible food – this is that derived matter.
Thus, the compilation of matter is fivefold.
The Pentad.
The Hexad

Visual form is form cognizable by eye-consciousness; sound form is form cognizable by ear-consciousness; odour form is form cognizable by nose-consciousness; taste form is form cognizable by tongue-consciousness; tangible form is form cognizable by body-consciousness; all form is form cognizable by mind-consciousness.
Thus is the compendium of matter in six ways.
The Sixfold Way
The Sevenfold Way

Visual form is form cognizable by eye-consciousness; sound form is form cognizable by ear-consciousness; odour form is form cognizable by nose-consciousness; taste form is form cognizable by tongue-consciousness; tangible form is form cognizable by body-consciousness; visual, sound, odour, taste, and tangible forms are forms cognizable by the mind-element consciousness; all form is form cognizable by the mind-consciousness-element consciousness.
Thus is the compendium of matter in seven ways.
The Sevenfold Way
The Eightfold Way

Visual form is form cognizable by eye-consciousness; sound form is form cognizable by ear-consciousness; odour form is form cognizable by nose-consciousness; taste form is form cognizable by tongue-consciousness; agreeable tangible form, pleasant contact, is form cognizable by body-consciousness; disagreeable tangible form, painful contact, is form cognizable by body-consciousness; visual, sound, odour, taste, and tangible forms are forms cognizable by the mind-element consciousness; all form is form cognizable by the mind-consciousness-element consciousness.
Thus is the compendium of matter in eight ways.
The Eightfold Group.
The Ninefold Group
What is that material form which is the eye-faculty? That eye, which is sensitive matter derived from the four great elements…pe… this is that material form which is the eye-faculty.

What is that material form which is the ear-faculty…pe… the nose-faculty…pe… the tongue-faculty…pe… the body-faculty…pe… the female-faculty…pe… the male-faculty…pe… the life-faculty? That which is the life, standing, maintaining, sustaining, carrying on, continuing, protecting, the life of those material phenomena, the life-faculty – this is that material form which is the life-faculty.
What is that material form which is not a faculty? Visual form…pe… edible food – this is that material form which is not a faculty.
Thus, the collection of material forms is in nine ways.
The Ninefold Group.
The Tenfold Group
What is that material form which is the eye-faculty? That eye, which is sensitive matter derived from the four great elements…pe… this is that material form which is the eye-faculty.

What is that material form which is the ear-faculty…pe… the nose-faculty…pe… the tongue-faculty…pe… the body-faculty…pe… the female-faculty…pe… the male-faculty…pe… the life-faculty? That which is the life, standing, maintaining, sustaining, carrying on, continuing, protecting, the life of those material phenomena, the life-faculty – this is that material form which is the life-faculty.
What is that material phenomenon which is not a faculty and has impingement? Visible object... up to... tangible object – this is that material phenomenon which is not a faculty and has impingement.

What is that material phenomenon which is not a faculty and does not have impingement? Bodily intimation... up to... nutritive essence – this is that material phenomenon which is not a faculty and does not have impingement.
Thus, the collection of material phenomena is tenfold.
The Decad.
The Undecad

What is that material phenomenon which is the eye-base? That eye which is a sensitive part dependent on the four great primaries... up to... a deserted village – this is that material phenomenon which is the eye-base.

What is that material phenomenon which is the ear-base... up to... the tangible object-base? Earth element... up to... tangible element – this is that material phenomenon which is the tangible object-base.

What is that material phenomenon which is non-manifesting, without impingement, and included in the dhamma-base? Femininity faculty... up to... nutritive essence – this is that material phenomenon which is non-manifesting, without impingement, and included in the dhamma-base.
Thus, the collection of material phenomena is elevenfold.
The Undecad.
Eighth Recitation Section.
Classification of Matter.
The Section on Matter is concluded.
3. Compendium of Categories
Exposition of Triads

Which phenomena are wholesome? The three wholesome roots—non-greed, non-hatred, non-delusion; the feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, formation aggregate, and consciousness aggregate associated with them; and the bodily kamma, verbal kamma, and mental kamma arisen from them—these phenomena are wholesome.

Which phenomena are unwholesome? The three unwholesome roots—greed, hatred, delusion; and the defilements co-existent with them; the feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, formation aggregate, and consciousness aggregate associated with them; and the bodily kamma, verbal kamma, and mental kamma arisen from them—these phenomena are unwholesome.

Which phenomena are indeterminate? The resultants of wholesome and unwholesome phenomena in the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere, and supramundane; the feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, formation aggregate, and consciousness aggregate; and those functional phenomena that are neither wholesome nor unwholesome nor kamma-resultants; and all matter, and the unconditioned element—these phenomena are indeterminate.

Which phenomena are associated with pleasant feeling? In the plane of pleasant feeling, in the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, and supramundane, excluding pleasant feeling; the perception aggregate, formation aggregate, and consciousness aggregate associated with it—these phenomena are associated with pleasant feeling.

Which phenomena are associated with painful feeling? In the plane of painful feeling, in the sense sphere, excluding painful feeling; the perception aggregate, formation aggregate, and consciousness aggregate associated with it—these phenomena are associated with painful feeling.

Which phenomena are associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling?⤵The aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, and the aggregate of consciousness, in the sense, fine-material, immaterial, and transcendent spheres, associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, excluding the feeling itself.

Which phenomena are results?⤵The results of wholesome and unwholesome phenomena in the sense, fine-material, immaterial, and transcendent spheres, namely, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, and the aggregate of consciousness.

Which phenomena have the nature of producing results?⤵Wholesome and unwholesome phenomena in the sense, fine-material, immaterial, and transcendent spheres, namely, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, and the aggregate of consciousness.

Which phenomena are neither results nor having the nature of producing results?⤵Functional phenomena that are neither wholesome nor unwholesome and not kamma-results; all material phenomena; and the unconditioned element.

Which phenomena are clung to and graspable?⤵The results of wholesome and unwholesome phenomena, subject to taints, in the sense, fine-material, and immaterial spheres, namely, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, and the aggregate of consciousness; and matter born of kamma.

Which phenomena are not clung to, but graspable?⤵Wholesome and unwholesome phenomena, subject to taints, in the sense, fine-material, and immaterial spheres, namely, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, and the aggregate of consciousness; functional phenomena that are neither wholesome nor unwholesome and not kamma-results; and matter not born of kamma.
Which phenomena are neither clung to nor graspable?⤵The transcendent paths, their fruits, and the unconditioned element.

Which phenomena are defiled and defiling?⤵The three unwholesome roots – greed, hatred, delusion; associated defilements; the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, and the aggregate of consciousness associated with them; and bodily, verbal, and mental action arising from them.

Which phenomena are undefiled but defiling?⤵Wholesome and indeterminate phenomena, subject to taints, in the sense, fine-material, and immaterial spheres, namely, the aggregate of matter, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, and the aggregate of consciousness.
Which phenomena are neither defiled nor defiling?⤵The transcendent paths, their fruits, and the unconditioned element.

Which phenomena are accompanied by initial application and sustained application?⤵The feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, volitional formations aggregate, and consciousness aggregate, associated with them, in the sphere of initial and sustained application (sense sphere, fine-material sphere, and supramundane), excluding initial application and sustained application. These phenomena are accompanied by initial application and sustained application.

Which phenomena are without initial application, only sustained application?⤵The feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, volitional formations aggregate, and consciousness aggregate, associated with them, in the sphere of only sustained application (fine-material sphere and supramundane), excluding sustained application. These phenomena are without initial application, only sustained application.

Which phenomena are without initial application and without sustained application?⤵The feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, volitional formations aggregate, and consciousness aggregate, in the sphere without initial and sustained application (sense sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere, and supramundane); all material phenomena; and the unconditioned element. These phenomena are without initial application and without sustained application.

Which phenomena are accompanied by joy?⤵The feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, volitional formations aggregate, and consciousness aggregate, associated with them, in the sphere of joy (sense sphere, fine-material sphere, and supramundane), excluding joy. These phenomena are accompanied by joy.

Which phenomena are accompanied by happiness?⤵The perception aggregate, volitional formations aggregate, and consciousness aggregate, associated with them, in the sphere of happiness (sense sphere, fine-material sphere, and supramundane), excluding happiness. These phenomena are accompanied by happiness.

Which phenomena are accompanied by equanimity?⤵The perception aggregate, volitional formations aggregate, and consciousness aggregate, associated with them, in the sphere of equanimity (sense sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere, and supramundane), excluding equanimity. These phenomena are accompanied by equanimity.
Which phenomena are to be abandoned by vision?⤵The three fetters: personality view, doubt, and adherence to rites and rituals.

What is personality view?⤵Here, an uninstructed worldling, not seeing noble ones, unskilled in the Dhamma of noble ones, untrained in the Dhamma of noble ones; not seeing good men, unskilled in the Dhamma of good men, untrained in the Dhamma of good men, regards form as self, or self as having form, or form as in self, or self as in form; regards feeling as self, or self as having feeling, or feeling as in self, or self as in feeling; regards perception as self, or self as having perception, or perception as in self, or self as in perception; regards volitional formations as self, or self as having volitional formations, or volitional formations as in self, or self as in volitional formations; regards consciousness as self, or self as having consciousness, or consciousness as in self, or self as in consciousness. Whatever such view, wrong view, thicket of views, wilderness of views, distortion of views, vacillation of views, fetter of views, grasping, clinging, adherence, obsession, wrong path, false way, wrongness, sectarian position, inverted grasp – this is called personality view.

What is doubt?⤵Doubts, is perplexed about, the Teacher; doubts, is perplexed about, the Dhamma; doubts, is perplexed about, the Saṅgha; doubts, is perplexed about, the training; doubts, is perplexed about, the past; doubts, is perplexed about, the future; doubts, is perplexed about, both past and future; doubts, is perplexed about, dependent arising and dependently arisen phenomena. Whatever such wavering, state of wavering, perplexity, doubt, two-way path, uncertainty, grasping at many sides, vacillation, wandering, lack of penetration, stiffness of mind, mental defilement – this is called doubt.

What is adherence to rites and rituals?⤵Among recluses and brahmins outside this doctrine, the view 'purification by virtue, purification by rites, purification by virtue and rites'. Whatever such view, wrong view, thicket of views, wilderness of views, distortion of views, vacillation of views, fetter of views, grasping, clinging, adherence, obsession, wrong path, false way, wrongness, sectarian position, inverted grasp – this is called adherence to rites and rituals.

These three fetters; and defilements associated with them; the feeling aggregate... up to the consciousness aggregate associated with them; bodily action, vocal action, mental action arising from them – these phenomena are to be abandoned by seeing.

Which phenomena are to be abandoned by development? The remaining greed, hatred, delusion; and defilements associated with them; the feeling aggregate... up to the consciousness aggregate associated with them; bodily action, vocal action, mental action arising from them – these phenomena are to be abandoned by development.

Which phenomena are to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development? Wholesome and indeterminate phenomena belonging to the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere, and unincluded; the feeling aggregate... up to the consciousness aggregate; and all matter, and the unconditioned element – these phenomena are to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development.
Which phenomena have causes to be abandoned by seeing? The three fetters: identity view, doubt, clinging to rites and rituals.
Therein, what is identity view? ... This is called identity view.
Therein, what is doubt? ... This is called doubt.
Therein, what is clinging to rites and rituals? ... This is called clinging to rites and rituals.

These three fetters; and defilements associated with them; the feeling aggregate... up to the consciousness aggregate associated with them; bodily action, vocal action, mental action arising from them – these phenomena have causes to be abandoned by seeing. The three fetters – identity view, doubt, clinging to rites and rituals – these phenomena are to be abandoned by seeing. Greed, hatred, delusion associated with them – these phenomena are the causes to be abandoned by seeing. And defilements associated with them; the feeling aggregate... up to the consciousness aggregate associated with them; bodily action, vocal action, mental action arising from them – these phenomena have causes to be abandoned by seeing.

Which phenomena have causes to be abandoned by development? The remaining greed, hatred, delusion – these phenomena are the causes to be abandoned by development. And defilements associated with them; the feeling aggregate... up to the consciousness aggregate associated with them; bodily action, vocal action, mental action arising from them – these phenomena have causes to be abandoned by development.

Which phenomena have causes to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development? Excluding those phenomena, the remaining wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate phenomena belonging to the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere, and unincluded; the feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, formation aggregate, consciousness aggregate; and all matter, and the unconditioned element – these phenomena have causes to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development.

States that lead to accumulation are: Tainted wholesome and unwholesome phenomena of the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, and immaterial sphere; the feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, mental formations aggregate, and consciousness aggregate.
States that lead to reduction are: The four supramundane paths.

States that lead neither to accumulation nor to reduction are: Results of wholesome and unwholesome phenomena of the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere, and supramundane; the feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, mental formations aggregate, and consciousness aggregate; functional states that are neither wholesome nor unwholesome nor kamma-results; all material phenomena; and the unconditioned element.
States of trainees are: The four supramundane paths, and the three lower fruits of spiritual attainment.
States of perfected ones are: The highest fruit, Arahantship.

States that are neither of trainees nor of perfected ones are: Excluding those states, the remaining wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate phenomena of the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, and immaterial sphere; the feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, mental formations aggregate, and consciousness aggregate; all material phenomena; and the unconditioned element.

Limited states are: All wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate phenomena of the sense sphere; the matter aggregate, feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, mental formations aggregate, and consciousness aggregate.

Sublime states are: Wholesome and indeterminate phenomena of the fine-material and immaterial spheres; the feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, mental formations aggregate, and consciousness aggregate.
Illimitable states are: The supramundane paths, the fruits of the paths, and the unconditioned element.
States with limited objects are: Those consciousness and mental factors that arise taking limited states as their object.
Which are the states that have a sublime object? Mental states and mental factors that arise taking sublime phenomena as their object are states with a sublime object.
Which are the states that have an immeasurable object? Mental states and mental factors that arise taking immeasurable phenomena as their object are states with an immeasurable object.

Which are the inferior states? The three unwholesome roots—greed, hatred, delusion—and associated defilements; the feeling aggregate up to the consciousness aggregate associated with them; and bodily, verbal, and mental kamma originating from them are inferior states.

Which are the middling states? Wholesome and indeterminate states subject to taints, belonging to the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, and immaterial sphere; and the form aggregate up to the consciousness aggregate are middling states.
Which are the sublime states? The unincluded paths, the fruits of the paths, and the unconditioned element (Nibbāna) are sublime states.
Which are the states fixed in wrongness? The five heinous actions and wrong view fixed in certainty are states fixed in wrongness.
Which are the states fixed in rightness? The four unincluded paths are states fixed in rightness.

Which are the indeterminate states? Except for those states, the remaining wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states belonging to the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere, and unincluded; the feeling aggregate up to the consciousness aggregate; all matter; and the unconditioned element (Nibbāna) are indeterminate states.
Which are the states that have the Noble Path as their object? Mental states and mental factors that arise taking the Noble Path as their object are states with the Noble Path as their object.

Which are the states rooted in the Path? For one endowed with the Noble Path, the feeling aggregate up to the consciousness aggregate associated with the path factors (excluding the path factors themselves) are states rooted in the Path. For one endowed with the Noble Path, right view is both path and root; the feeling aggregate up to the consciousness aggregate associated with it (excluding right view itself) are states rooted in the Path. For one endowed with the Noble Path, non-greed, non-hatred, and non-delusion are the roots of the Path; the feeling aggregate up to the consciousness aggregate associated with them are states rooted in the Path.

Which are the dhammas that have the path as their dominant condition? Those consciousness and mental factors that arise making the Noble Path predominant. These dhammas have the path as their dominant condition. For one endowed with the Noble Path, cultivating the path with investigation as predominance, excluding investigation; the associated feeling aggregate...pe...consciousness aggregate. These dhammas have the path as their dominant condition.

Which are the arisen dhammas?⤵Those dhammas that are born, become, arisen, produced, manifested, appeared, arisen, come to pass, supervened, caused to arise, and are included in the category of arisen: form, feeling, perception, mental formations, consciousness. These dhammas are arisen.

Which are the not arisen dhammas? Those dhammas that are not born, not become, not arisen, not produced, not manifested, not appeared, not arisen, not come to pass, not supervened, not caused to arise, and are included in the category of not arisen: form, feeling, perception, mental formations, consciousness. These dhammas are not arisen.

Which are the dhammas capable of arising? The unripened results of wholesome and unwholesome dhammas, which are resultant, belonging to the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere, and not included in these; the feeling aggregate...pe...consciousness aggregate; and also the form that will arise due to kamma. These dhammas are capable of arising.

Which are the past dhammas? Those dhammas that are past, ceased, gone, changed, set, completely set, having arisen and then gone, past, and are included in the category of past: form, feeling, perception, mental formations, consciousness. These dhammas are past.

Which are the future dhammas? Those dhammas that are not born, not become, not arisen, not produced, not manifested, not appeared, not arisen, not come to pass, not supervened, not caused to arise, future, and are included in the category of future: form, feeling, perception, mental formations, consciousness. These dhammas are future.

Which are the present dhammas?⤵Those dhammas that are born, become, arisen, produced, manifested, appeared, arisen, come to pass, supervened, caused to arise, present, and are included in the category of present: form, feeling, perception, mental formations, consciousness. These dhammas are present.
Which are the dhammas with past objects?⤵Those consciousness and mental factors that arise taking past dhammas as their object. These dhammas have past objects.
Which are the dhammas with future objects?⤵Those consciousness and mental factors that arise taking future dhammas as their object. These dhammas have future objects.
Which are the dhammas with present objects?⤵Those consciousness and mental factors that arise taking present dhammas as their object. These dhammas have present objects.

What are internal phenomena?⤵Those phenomena of those beings that are internal, personal, fixed, pertaining to the individual, and appropriated: form, feeling, perception, mental formations, consciousness – these phenomena are internal.

What are external phenomena?⤵Those phenomena of other beings, other individuals, that are internal, personal, fixed, pertaining to the individual, and appropriated: form, feeling, perception, mental formations, consciousness – these phenomena are external.
What are internal and external phenomena?⤵Both of these – these phenomena are internal and external.
What are phenomena with internal objects?⤵Those consciousness and mental factors that arise taking internal phenomena as object – these phenomena have internal objects.
What are phenomena with external objects?⤵Those consciousness and mental factors that arise taking external phenomena as object – these phenomena have external objects.

What are phenomena with internal and external objects?⤵Those consciousness and mental factors that arise taking internal and external phenomena as object – these phenomena have internal and external objects.
What are visible and impinging phenomena?⤵The visible object – these phenomena are visible and impinging.
What are invisible and impinging phenomena?⤵The eye-base, ear-base, nose-base, tongue-base, body-base, sound-base, smell-base, taste-base, tangible-base – these phenomena are invisible and impinging.

What are invisible and non-impinging phenomena?⤵The feeling aggregate, perception aggregate, mental formations aggregate, consciousness aggregate; and that matter which is invisible and non-impinging, included in the dhamma-base; and the unconditioned element – these phenomena are invisible and non-impinging.
The Triad.
Exposition of Dyads
Cluster of Roots

Which states are roots? Three wholesome roots, three unwholesome roots, three indeterminate roots, nine sense-sphere roots, six fine-material sphere roots, six immaterial sphere roots, six supramundane roots.
Among these, which are the three wholesome roots? Non-greed, non-hatred, non-delusion.

Among these, what is non-greed?⤵That which is non-greed, not being greedy, the state of not being greedy, non-attachment, not being attached, the state of not being attached, non-covetousness, non-greed, a wholesome root—this is called non-greed.
