1. Classification According to the Abhidhamma

There are twenty-two faculties – the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, the body faculty, the mind faculty, the faculty of femininity, the faculty of masculinity, the life faculty, the faculty of pleasure, the faculty of pain, the faculty of gladness, the faculty of sadness, the faculty of equanimity, the faculty of confidence, the faculty of energy, the faculty of mindfulness, the faculty of concentration, the faculty of wisdom, the faculty of "I shall know what is not yet known", the faculty of final knowledge, and the faculty of one who has fully known.

Therein, what is the eye faculty? The eye that is a sensitive surface derived from the four great elements… this is an empty village – this is called "the eye faculty". ⤵ Therein, what is the ear faculty… the nose faculty… the tongue faculty… the body faculty? The body that is a sensitive surface derived from the four great elements… this is an empty village – this is called "the body faculty". ⤵ Therein, what is the mind faculty? As a single class, the mind faculty is joined with contact. As a twofold class: there is mind with a root cause, and mind without a root cause. As a threefold class: there is wholesome mind, unwholesome mind, and neutral mind. As a fourfold class: there is mind belonging to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, and mind not included in any sphere. As a fivefold class: there is mind joined with the faculty of pleasure, joined with the faculty of pain, joined with the faculty of gladness, joined with the faculty of sadness, and joined with the faculty of equanimity. As a sixfold class: there is eye-consciousness… mind-consciousness. This is the mind faculty as a sixfold class. ⤵ As a sevenfold class: there is eye-consciousness… body-consciousness, the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element. This is the mind faculty as a sevenfold class. ⤵ As an eightfold class: there is eye-consciousness… body-consciousness – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element. This is the mind faculty as an eightfold class. ⤵ As a ninefold class: there is eye-consciousness… body-consciousness, the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the mind faculty as a ninefold class. ⤵ As a tenfold class: there is eye-consciousness… body-consciousness – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the mind faculty as a tenfold class… thus the mind faculty is classified in many ways. This is called "the mind faculty". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of femininity? A woman's feminine features, feminine marks, feminine ways, feminine manner, femininity, the state of being a woman – this is called "the faculty of femininity". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of masculinity? A man's masculine features, masculine marks, masculine ways, masculine manner, masculinity, the state of being a man – this is called "the faculty of masculinity". ⤵ Therein, what is the life faculty? The life faculty is twofold: there is the material life faculty, and there is the immaterial life faculty. ⤵ Therein, what is the material life faculty? The life span of material states, their persistence, their keeping going, their being kept going, their continuing, their proceeding, their maintenance, their life, the life faculty – this is called "the material life faculty". ⤵ Therein, what is the immaterial life faculty? The life span of immaterial states, their persistence, their keeping going, their being kept going, their continuing, their proceeding, their maintenance, their life, the life faculty – this is called "the immaterial life faculty". This is called "the life faculty". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of pleasure? Bodily comfort, bodily pleasure; the comfortable, pleasant experience born of body-contact; the comfortable, pleasant feeling born of body-contact – this is called "the faculty of pleasure". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of pain? Bodily discomfort, bodily pain; the uncomfortable, painful experience born of body-contact; the uncomfortable, painful feeling born of body-contact – this is called "the faculty of pain". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of gladness? Mental comfort, mental pleasure; the comfortable, pleasant experience born of mind-contact; the comfortable, pleasant feeling born of mind-contact – this is called "the faculty of gladness". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of sadness? Mental discomfort, mental pain; the uncomfortable, painful experience born of mind-contact; the uncomfortable, painful feeling born of mind-contact – this is called "the faculty of sadness". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of equanimity? What is mentally neither comfortable nor uncomfortable; the experience born of mind-contact that is neither painful nor pleasant; the feeling born of mind-contact that is neither painful nor pleasant – this is called "the faculty of equanimity". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of confidence? The confidence, the trusting, the reliance, the deep trust; confidence, the faculty of confidence, the power of confidence – this is called "the faculty of confidence". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of energy? The mental arousing of energy, the exertion, the endeavour, the striving, the effort, the zeal, the persistence, the vigour, the steadiness, the unslackening endeavour, the not putting down of desire, the not putting down of the burden, the firm taking up of the burden; energy, the faculty of energy, the power of energy – this is called "the faculty of energy". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of mindfulness? The mindfulness, the remembering, the recollecting; mindfulness, the bearing in mind, the keeping in mind, the non-drifting, the non-forgetting; mindfulness, the faculty of mindfulness, the power of mindfulness, right mindfulness – this is called "the faculty of mindfulness". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of concentration? The steadiness of mind, the stability, the standing firm, the non-scattering, the non-distraction, the undistracted state of mind; calm, the faculty of concentration, the power of concentration, right concentration – this is called "the faculty of concentration". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of wisdom? The wisdom, the understanding… the non-delusion, the investigation of states, right view – this is called "the faculty of wisdom". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of "I shall know what is not yet known"? The wisdom, the understanding… the non-delusion, the investigation of states, the right view, the awakening factor of investigation of states that is a path factor, included in the path, for the realizing of those states not yet known, not yet seen, not yet reached, not yet found, not yet realized – this is called "the faculty of 'I shall know what is not yet known'". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of final knowledge? The wisdom, the understanding… the non-delusion, the investigation of states, the right view, the awakening factor of investigation of states that is a path factor, included in the path, for the realizing of those states that are known, seen, reached, found, and realized – this is called the faculty of final knowledge. ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of one who has fully known? The wisdom, the understanding… the non-delusion, the investigation of states, the right view, the awakening factor of investigation of states that is a path factor, included in the path, of one who has fully known those states that are seen, reached, found, and realized – this is called "the faculty of one who has fully known".

6. Analysis of Dependent Origination
1. Classification According to the Discourses

With ignorance as condition, formations; with formations as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality and material form; with mentality and material form as condition, the six sense-fields; with the six sense-fields as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, craving; with craving as condition, clinging; with clinging as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair come to be. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is ignorance? Not knowing suffering, not knowing the origin of suffering, not knowing the cessation of suffering, not knowing the way leading to the cessation of suffering — this is called "ignorance". ⤵ Therein, what are the formations that have ignorance as condition? The meritorious formation, the demeritorious formation, the imperturbable formation, the bodily formation, the verbal formation, the mental formation. ⤵ Therein, what is the meritorious formation? Wholesome intention belonging to the sense sphere or the fine-material sphere, made of giving, made of virtue, made of meditative development — this is called "the meritorious formation". ⤵ Therein, what is the demeritorious formation? Unwholesome intention belonging to the sense sphere — this is called "the demeritorious formation". ⤵ Therein, what is the imperturbable formation? Wholesome intention belonging to the immaterial sphere — this is called "the imperturbable formation". ⤵ Therein, what is the bodily formation? Bodily intention is the bodily formation; verbal intention is the verbal formation; mental intention is the mental formation. These are called "the formations that have ignorance as condition".

Therein, what is the consciousness that has formations as condition? Eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, mind-consciousness — this is called "the consciousness that has formations as condition".

Therein, what are the mentality and material form that have consciousness as condition? There is mentality, there is material form. Therein, what is mentality? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "mentality". Therein, what is material form? The four great elements and the material form derived from the four great elements — this is called "material form". So this is mentality and this is material form. This is called "the mentality and material form that have consciousness as condition".

Therein, what are the six sense-fields that have mentality and material form as condition? The eye sense-field, the ear sense-field, the nose sense-field, the tongue sense-field, the body sense-field, the mind sense-field — this is called "the six sense-fields that have mentality and material form as condition".

Therein, what is the contact that has the six sense-fields as condition? Eye-contact, ear-contact, nose-contact, tongue-contact, body-contact, mind-contact — this is called "the contact that has the six sense-fields as condition".

Therein, what is the feeling that has contact as condition? Feeling born of eye-contact, feeling born of ear-contact, feeling born of nose-contact, feeling born of tongue-contact, feeling born of body-contact, feeling born of mind-contact — this is called "the feeling that has contact as condition".

Therein, what is the craving that has feeling as condition? Craving for sights, craving for sounds, craving for smells, craving for tastes, craving for tangible things, craving for mental objects — this is called "the craving that has feeling as condition".

Therein, what is the clinging that has craving as condition? Clinging to sense pleasures, clinging to views, clinging to rules and observances, clinging to a doctrine of self — this is called "the clinging that has craving as condition".

Therein, what is the existence that has clinging as condition? Existence is twofold: there is action-existence and there is rebirth-existence. Therein, what is action-existence? The meritorious formation, the demeritorious formation, the imperturbable formation — this is called "action-existence". All action that leads to existence is action-existence. ⤵ Therein, what is rebirth-existence? Sense-sphere existence, fine-material existence, immaterial existence, percipient existence, non-percipient existence, neither-percipient-nor-non-percipient existence, one-constituent existence, four-constituent existence, five-constituent existence — this is called "rebirth-existence". So this is action-existence and this is rebirth-existence. This is called "the existence that has clinging as condition".

Therein, what is the birth that has existence as condition? The birth of the various beings in the various classes of beings, their being born, their descent, their coming forth, the appearance of the aggregates, the obtaining of the sense-fields — this is called "the birth that has existence as condition".

Therein, what are the aging and death that have birth as condition? There is aging, there is death. Therein, what is aging? The aging of the various beings in the various classes of beings, their growing old, broken teeth, grey hair, wrinkled skin, the decline of the life span, the ripening of the faculties — this is called "aging". ⤵ Therein, what is death? The passing away of the various beings from the various classes of beings, their passing on, breakup, disappearance, dying, death, the completion of their time, the breakup of the aggregates, the laying down of the body, the cutting off of the life faculty — this is called "death". So this is aging and this is death. This is called "the aging and death that have birth as condition".

Therein, what is sorrow? For one touched by loss of relatives, touched by loss of wealth, touched by loss through illness, touched by loss of virtue, or touched by loss of view; for one who meets with some misfortune or other, touched by some painful thing or other — the sorrow, sorrowing, state of sorrowing, inner sorrow, inner deep sorrow, the burning of the mind, grief, the dart of sorrow — this is called "sorrow".

Therein, what is lamentation? For one touched by loss of relatives, touched by loss of wealth, touched by loss through illness, touched by loss of virtue, or touched by loss of view; for one who meets with some misfortune or other, touched by some painful thing or other — the crying, lamenting, act of crying, act of lamenting, state of crying, state of lamenting, wordy talk, babbling, wailing, the act of wailing, the state of wailing — this is called "lamentation".
Therein, what is pain? Bodily discomfort, bodily pain, the uncomfortable painful experience born of body-contact, the uncomfortable painful feeling born of body-contact — this is called "pain".
Therein, what is grief? Mental discomfort, mental pain, the uncomfortable painful experience born of mind-contact, the uncomfortable painful feeling born of mind-contact — this is called "grief".

Therein, what is despair? For one touched by loss of relatives, touched by loss of wealth, touched by loss through illness, touched by loss of virtue, or touched by loss of view; for one who meets with some misfortune or other, touched by some painful thing or other — the distress, despair, state of distress, state of despair — this is called "despair".

"Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering": thus there is the coming together of this entire mass of suffering, its meeting, its combination, its appearance. Therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".
The Classification According to the Discourses is finished.

On the occasion when, because sense-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, resultant ear-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sound as its object… nose-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a smell as its object… tongue-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a taste as its object… body-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by happiness, with a tangible thing as its object… the mind element has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object… or a tangible thing as its object… the mind-consciousness element has arisen, accompanied by joy, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object… the mind-consciousness element has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because sense-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, the resultant mind-consciousness element has arisen, accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge… accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge, with prompting… accompanied by joy, dissociated from knowledge… accompanied by joy, dissociated from knowledge, with prompting… accompanied by equanimity, associated with knowledge… accompanied by equanimity, associated with knowledge, with prompting… accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge… accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge, with prompting, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when one develops the path for rebirth in the fine-material sphere — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption on the earth device — on that occasion there is contact… there is non-distraction — these things are wholesome. ⤵ When, because that same fine-material-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, as its result — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption on the earth device — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when one develops the path for rebirth in the immaterial sphere — completely passing beyond the field of nothingness, accompanied by the perception of the field of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, with the abandoning of happiness… one enters and dwells in the fourth meditative absorption — on that occasion there is contact… there is non-distraction — these things are wholesome. ⤵ When, because that same immaterial-sphere wholesome action has been done and accumulated, as its result — completely passing beyond the field of nothingness, accompanied by the perception of the field of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, with the abandoning of happiness… one enters and dwells in the fourth meditative absorption — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when one develops the meditative absorption that is beyond the world, leading out, leading to dismantling, for the abandoning of views, for reaching the first stage — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption, of difficult practice and slow direct knowledge — on that occasion there is contact… there is non-distraction — these things are wholesome. ⤵ When, because that same wholesome meditative absorption beyond the world has been done and developed, as its result — secluded from sense pleasures… one enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption, of difficult practice and slow direct knowledge, on emptiness — on that occasion, with a wholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, confidence; with confidence as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of these things.
The Exposition of Results Rooted in the Wholesome.
14. The Exposition of Results Rooted in the Unwholesome

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because unwholesome action has been done and accumulated, resultant eye-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object — on that occasion, with an unwholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is the formation that has an unwholesome root as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has an unwholesome root as condition"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because unwholesome action has been done and accumulated, resultant ear-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sound as its object… nose-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a smell as its object… tongue-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a taste as its object… body-consciousness has arisen, accompanied by pain, with a tangible thing as its object… the mind element has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object… or a tangible thing as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with an unwholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Which things are neutral? On the occasion when, because unwholesome action has been done and accumulated, the resultant mind-consciousness element has arisen, accompanied by equanimity, with a sight as its object… or a mental object as its object, or based on whatever it may be — on that occasion, with an unwholesome root as condition, a formation; with the formation as condition, consciousness; with consciousness as condition, mentality; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact; with contact as condition, feeling; with feeling as condition, decision; with decision as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

Therein, what is the formation that has an unwholesome root as condition? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has an unwholesome root as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the consciousness that has the formation as condition? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the consciousness that has the formation as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the mentality that has consciousness as condition? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "the mentality that has consciousness as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition? The contact, touching, being in contact, state of being in contact — this is called "the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the feeling that has contact as condition? Mental experience that is neither comfortable nor uncomfortable, the neither-painful-nor-pleasant experience born of mind-contact, the neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling born of mind-contact — this is called "the feeling that has contact as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the decision that has feeling as condition? The decision of the mind, deciding, the state of being decided upon — this is called "the decision that has feeling as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the existence that has decision as condition? Setting aside decision: the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness — this is called "the existence that has decision as condition". ⤵ Therein, what is the birth that has existence as condition? The birth of the various states, their being born, arising, coming forth, appearance — this is called "the birth that has existence as condition". ⤵ Therein, what are the aging and death that have birth as condition? There is aging, there is death. Therein, what is aging? The aging of the various states, their growing old, the decline of their life span — this is called aging. Therein, what is death? The destruction of the various states, their vanishing, breakup, disintegration, impermanence, disappearance — this is called "death". So this is aging and this is death. This is called "the aging and death that have birth as condition". ⤵ "Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering": thus there is the coming together of this entire mass of suffering, its meeting, its combination, its appearance. Therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".
The Exposition of Results Rooted in the Unwholesome.
The Classification According to the Abhidhamma is finished.
The Analysis of Dependent Origination is finished.
